[[File:Charon_warrior.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Charon warrior]]
A '''warrior''' was a specialized form of the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]]. They had eight limbs, dull coloration, and were masters of stealth. They had [[web spinneret]]s to trap enemies, a [[plasma blaster]], and clawed arms that transmitted [[Charon venom|poison]].

While the [[Charon Death Cult]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Desolate]]'' hung in [[Otherspace]], hundreds of [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] slumbered in the [[chamber of sleep]]. [[Ber'asco]], the [[Prophet of the Void]], commanded them to awaken when the ship was boarded by outsiders.

Charon warriors did [[Skirmish on the Desolate|battle]] with a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] aboard the ''Desolate'', including a skirmish in the ship's [[chamber of armor]], where they donned their specialized [[Charon battle armor|battle armor]].
